1.m_mDesc: "After selecting a difficulty, choose your destination and attempt the stage for your fastest clear time!"

2.m_mDesc:
"Build your mechanical spider based on the recommendations for the best results!
Complete tasks to obtain new Spider Parts."

3.m_mDesc: "You'll encounter many events during your adventure, some of which require making choices. These events take varying amounts of time, and your Mechanical Spider risks taking damage."

4.m_mDesc:
"Victory is achieved by completing all events and reaching the final destination. Trophies will be awarded based on the finish time.
An attempt ends when durability reaches 0."

5.m_mDesc: "Complete stages to obtain new Spider Parts. After earning a number of trophies, you may claim your rewards!"
